Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /workspace/config/models.yaml:
     1	# All model IDs are OpenRouter model slugs (https://openrouter.ai/models).
     2	# Swap any of these freely — nothing else in the codebase hardcodes a model name.
     3	
     4	# The model under audit. Also wears the CLEAN/LOYAL system prompts.
     5	target: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash
     6	
     7	# The Auditor's own reasoning model (auditor/agent.py). Cheap, many calls per run.
     8	auditor_brain: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash
     9	
    10	# Grades organism-validation comparisons AND Auditor reports against ground truth.
    11	# Deliberately a different model family than target/auditor_brain to avoid
    12	# correlated blind spots.
    13	judge: openai/gpt-5-mini
    14	
    15	# The Optimizer's (OpenHands') reasoning model. Not used by this Python harness
    16	# directly — referenced here so optimizer/run_optimizer.sh has one place to read
    17	# it from.
    18	optimizer_brain: deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro
    19
